articles.summary: Primis Bank today announced the evolution of V1BE into Banking Valet, a reimagined concierge banking service that combines in-person banking convenience with a redesigned digital experience. The transition positions the service for future expansion while preserving the personalized customer experience that has distinguished it since launch.
articles.title: V1BE to Become Banking Valet as Primis Bank Positions Concierge Banking Service for Future Growth - Primis Bank
